title: Exact Clique Counts in Graphs with a Forbidden Tree
summary: For a fixed tree $T$ on $t$ vertices, let $\ex(n,K_r,T)$ denote the maximum number of $r$-cliques in an $n$-vertex $T$-free graph. Write $n=α(t-1)+β$ with $0\leβ<t-1$. A conjecture proposed in extremal-graph form by Alon and Shikhelman~\cite{alon2016}, later stated explicitly as an exact clique-counting formula by Gerbner and Palmer~\cite{GP2026}, asserts that \[ \ex(n,K_r,T)=α\binom{t-1}{r}+\binomβr, \] with the extremal construction given by the vertex disjoint union of $α$ copies of $K_{t-1}$ and a graph with $β$ vertices. This paper proves this conjecture for every $n$ and for every tree…
